summary: Implemented retry(operation, attempts) in net/retry.py per DECISIONS.md: total-call attempts, ValueError for attempts < 1, retries only TransientError with delays() backoff through the injected or default SystemClock, and re-raises the last TransientError. Added 6 FakeClock-based tests; the suite passes (8 passed, baseline 1 failed).
assumptions: Followed DECISIONS.md D-3 (retry only TransientError) rather than Issue #41's 'retry on any exception'; canonical policy was not changed.
Backoff uses net.backoff.delays() defaults (base 0.1, factor 2, cap 5) per D-2.
attempts is the total number of calls including the first, per D-4.
questions_for_requester: Does the pricing service client raise TransientError for timeouts and 503s? If it raises other exception types, this change will not retry them.
Issue #41 asks for retry on any exception, but D-3 retries only TransientError. Confirm D-3 should stand for the pricing service, or approve a policy change.
